ModMetaData.name: Planetsmith
ModMetaData.author: aspctt
ModMetaData.description:
Planetsmith is a world-generation overhaul: a physically-motivated climate simulation and a competitive biome-scoring system that replace vanilla's binary biome placement, plus per-world generation controls and presets.
This is an original, clean-room implementation. It does not include code from, or depend on, any other mod.
